headline: A massive gain for the Chiefs!
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw a long pass to T.Thornton, who caught it and ran all the way to the one-yard line for a huge gain.
who: P.Mahomes threw the ball to T.Thornton.
why_it_matters: This is great news for our Chiefs! This big play moved us way closer to the end zone and jumped our chances of winning by 22 percent.
